daily_bar_business_observation_time.evidence: Daily bar trade date/session completion is intrinsic business-time evidence; the accepted ODS PIT audit allows a governed session-completion lower bound for economic availability.

daily_bar_historical_acquisition_time.evidence: The accepted ODS PIT audit states that historical acquisition time is absent for security_market_bars; daily built_at values belong to the 2026 package construction period.

daily_bar_complete_historical_revision_f.evidence: The ODS final contract publishes one canonical daily_ohlcv_unadjusted historical dataset plus later 2026 increment/source-evidence families, but does not bind a complete 2020 per-session source-version/receipt family proving which bar revision was uniquely visible at each T cutoff.

dwd_knowledge_from_as_public_arrival.evidence: The accepted Stage/Facts adapter declares dwd_known_from to be source metadata rather than public arrival or historical platform use, and the B2 lane explicitly admits retrospective view only.

p4_session_close_projection_as_strict_pi.evidence: The P4 development projection uses table-specific economic availability including session_close but remains approved_development_retrospective with per_decision_publication_proven=false; it cannot be promoted into strict public-reconstruction authority.

realized_calendar.evidence: Accepted ODS rules allow conservative realized-session/date completion without future-schedule authority.

security_listing_identity.evidence: Stable identity/effective interval reconstruction is allowed only under the conservative identity contract; unevidenced historical display/reference attributes stay unavailable.

corporate_action_coordinate_epoch.evidence: The Stage route uses action-epoch reset. Any action affecting an observation dependency closure would require announcement/availability evidence no later than the historical cutoff; future-known actions cannot be backfilled.

source_version_selector_requirement.evidence: The frozen temporal selector requires a complete revision family and authenticated availability evidence for historical public reconstruction. Current daily-bar authority does not prove that family.

decisive_blocker.reason: Strict public reconstruction needs the exact historical bar version family or independently authenticated equivalent source-version evidence. Current governed ODS/DWD authority proves the historical values and a session-completion lower bound, but not which unique value revision was publicly available by each 2020 T cutoff.
decisive_blocker.why_session_close_alone_is_insufficient: Session close answers when a completed daily bar could become knowable in principle; it does not prove that the present-day retained value is the unique version that was then available or that no later correction/revision altered it.
decisive_blocker.affected_population: all P029 observations because Stage10/11 causal closure depends on historical daily bars

not_attempted_after_decisive_blocker: No Stage10/11 PIT predicates were recomputed.
No retrospective observation was dropped or replaced.
No new historical data source was introduced.
No threshold, parent relation, evidence grade, primary_stage policy, or consumer authority was changed.
claim_ceiling: P030-B proves a repository-level capability blocker for strict Stage10/11 PUBLIC_RECONSTRUCTION under the frozen evidence standard. It does not prove that the retrospective Stage10/11 predicates are wrong, nor that a strict PIT reconstruction is impossible in principle if new independently governed historical source-version evidence is later admitted.
